items.notes: Created handlers for chronyd, rsyslog, and redis service restarts.

items.description: Role default variables: redis_port, redis_password (vault), maxmemory_mb, maxmemory_policy, manage_ntp, manage_syslog, manage_utils
items.notes: Created defaults/main.yml with all role variables: Redis config, myapp deployment, health check, base OS toggles, and secure_logging toggle.

items.description: Role argument specs for fail-fast parameter validation (generate after defaults/main.yml)
items.notes: Created meta/argument_specs.yml documenting all role parameters including AAP credential variables.

items.description: Main tasks entry point — orchestrates base OS setup (NTP, syslog, utils) and Redis cluster configuration
items.notes: Converted role::redis_cluster to tasks/main.yml. Validates credentials first, then applies base OS profile and Redis cluster profile in order, gated on Linux kernel fact.

items.description: Base OS profile tasks: install and enable chrony (NTP) and rsyslog (syslog), include base_utils packages
items.notes: Converted profile::base::base to tasks/base.yml. Installs chrony, rsyslog, and utility packages with toggle variables.

items.description: Redis cluster init tasks: health-check URI call, write health_check.json, myapp deployment (myDeploy1 → get_url/unarchive/copy), mySecretType1 scheduler registration (NOT SAFELY CONVERTIBLE — stub/placeholder), redis_role fact detection
items.notes: Moved include_tasks: install.yml to the top of redis_cluster.yml so the redis package (and its system user/group) is installed before any task references owner: redis or writes to /var/lib/redis

items.description: Redis install tasks: install redis package, configure redis (bind, port, requirepass, maxmemory, appendonly, appendfsync), manage redis service, ensure /var/log/redis directory
items.notes: Converted install.pp to tasks/install.yml. Installs redis package, deploys redis.conf.j2 template with no_log for password, ensures log dir, enables service.

items.description: myapp artifact deployment tasks: stat/slurp version.txt idempotency gate, get_url download tarball, file ensure directory, unarchive extract, copy write version.txt
items.notes: Converted myDeployProvider.rb to tasks/deploy_myapp.yml. Uses stat+slurp for idempotency check, get_url, unarchive, and copy for version.txt.

items.description: redis_role fact detection tasks: stat /etc/redis/conf.d/replica.conf, slurp content, set_fact redis_role as primary or replica
items.notes: Converted redis_role.rb facter to tasks/detect_redis_role.yml. Uses stat+slurp to check /etc/redis/conf.d/replica.conf and set redis_role fact.

items.description: NOT SAFELY CONVERTIBLE: Enterprise Scheduler registration stub — schedulerctl register --schedule daily redis-node; requires schedulerctl CLI documentation before full implementation
items.notes: NOT SAFELY CONVERTIBLE: Created stub task file with detailed developer notes explaining why schedulerctl cannot be automatically converted and what steps are needed. Includes a debug warning task.

items.description: Molecule scenario configuration — delegated driver, local connection (not docker/podman)
Molecule converge playbook — runs the role via ansible.builtin.include_role
items.notes: Generated converge.yml with single ansible.builtin.include_role task for profile_redis_cluster_case3.

items.description: Molecule verify playbook — checks /var/lib/redis/health_check.json (exists, owned redis:redis, mode 0644, valid JSON), /opt/myapp/version.txt (contains 2.1.0), /opt/myapp/ (directory exists), /var/log/redis (directory, owned redis:redis, mode 0755), redis port 6379 responds to PING, health endpoint returns JSON
items.notes: Generated verify.yml split into two plays: (1) file/directory stat+assert checks for /var/log/redis, /var/lib/redis/health_check.json, /opt/myapp, /opt/myapp/version.txt, /etc/redis/redis.conf; (2) service_facts assertions for redis, chronyd, rsyslog and wait_for port 6379.
